title: Fibonacci Stream and Digit Threshold

visible.label: Generator yields standard Fibonacci prefix
visible.script:
import itertools
g = fibonacci_gen()
assert list(itertools.islice(g, 8)) == [0, 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13]

hidden.label: Lazy generator supports large 50-digit check quickly
Independent generator instances do not share state
hidden.script:
g1, g2 = fibonacci_gen(), fibonacci_gen()
assert [next(g1), next(g1), next(g2)] == [0, 1, 0]

hints: Inside fibonacci_gen(), initialize a, b = 0, 1 and loop while True: yield a; a, b = b, a + b.
For first_fib_with_digits(digits): iterate enumerate(fibonacci_gen()) and return idx as soon as val >= 10**(digits - 1) (or 0 when digits <= 1).
